text: Let \(q\) smallest prime power exists integer \(k \geq 1\) \(q^k \geq N\) \(L = d(k-1)+1 \leq q+1\). Associate individual \(\) polynomial \(f_i(x)\) degree \(k-1\) whose coefficient vector base-\(q\) expansion \(-1\): $$   f_i(x)   =   c_0() + c_1()x + \cdots + c_{k-1}()x^{k-1},   \quad   - 1 = \sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} c_\ell() q^\ell. $$ Choose \(L = d(k-1)+1\) distinct evaluation points \(x_1, \ldots, x_L\) projective line \(GF(q)\) index pools \((\ell, v)\) \(\ell \\{1,\ldots,L\}\) \(v \GF(q)\). \(J = L q\) $$   M_{ji} = 1   \;\Longleftrightarrow\;   f_i(x_\ell) = v,   \quad j = (\ell-1)q + v + 1. $$ two Reed-Solomon codewords agree \(k-1\) evaluation positions, choice \(L > d(k-1)\) satisfies Kautz-Singleton disjunctness criterion, hence resulting binary design \(d\)-disjunct therefore \(d\)-separable. argument M ignored method \(J\) fixed \(q\), \(k\), \(d\).

text: Let \(\mathbf{M} \\{0,1\}^{J \times N}\) denote pooling design matrix let \(\widetilde{\mathbf{y}} = (\widetilde{y}_1, \ldots, \widetilde{y}_N)^\top\) denote latent individual-status vector. latent pool statuses computed $$   \widetilde{z}_j   =   \mathbb{}\left(     \sum_{= 1}^N M_{ji}\widetilde{y}_i > 0   \right),   \qquad   j \\{1, \ldots, J\}. $$ Equivalently, $$   \widetilde{\mathbf{z}}   =   \left(     \mathbb{}\left((\mathbf{M}\widetilde{\mathbf{y}})_1 > 0\right),     \ldots,     \mathbb{}\left((\mathbf{M}\widetilde{\mathbf{y}})_J > 0\right)   \right)^\top. $$ s_e s_p NULL, observed outcome vector equals latent pool-status vector, \(\mathbf{z} = \widetilde{\mathbf{z}}\). Otherwise function samples \(z_j \mid \widetilde{z}_j\) using supplied pool-level sensitivity specificity parameters.
